name: Chinese Astrology
policy: 80/20 verified practical BaZi core; not exhaustive Chinese astrology or predictive validation

supported.calculation: Four Pillars, Day Master, all10 stems/12 branches/60 pairs; symbolic phase/polarity counts. Gregorian local birth years1901–2100; existing offline DE440s kernel.
supported.astronomy: Independent apparent geocentric true-ecliptic/equinox solar roots for all24 terms. Li Chun315 degrees; jie315+30*k starts months. Same physical boundaries both hemispheres.

profiles.civil-zi23: Civil wall clock including IANA DST; day23:00; whole late-Zi hour next-day stem.
profiles.civil-split-zi: Civil wall clock including IANA DST; day00:00; late-Zi hour still next-day stem.
profiles.standard-zi23: Explicit alternative civil minus IANA DST; day23:00. No longitude/equation-of-time correction.

supported.animal: HKO published CNY dates1901–2100 applied at local civil midnight, separately labeled from BaZi year; not full lunar-calendar conversion.
supported.interpretation: All100 Ten Gods phase/polarity relationships;12 fixed modern hidden-stem sets;10 source-specific classical Day Master imagery components;4 pillar topics; explicit compositional chart-context explanations and symbolic element interactions.
supported.interfaces: bazi CLI JSON and Markdown; Python chart/enrich; source/rule/clock/root traces and reproducibility hashes.

experimental: Classical imagery composed under modern clock profiles is pedagogical source-labeled context, not a reconstructed historical practice.
Births within120 seconds of a jie are flagged for input/model sensitivity; exact arithmetic boundary does not guarantee physical time accuracy.
unsupported: Luck-pillar starting ages, absolute onset and personal timing forecasts
Automatic stem/branch combination transformations, special patterns and obscure lineage exceptions
Historical Julian calendars, ancient dynasty epochs, lunar birth-date input and worldwide lunar calendar reconstruction
Direct personal event predictions or predictive accuracy scores

verification.primary: 26 minute-rounded HKO solar-term times (all24 in2014; Li Chun/Jing Zhe2026); HKO Jia-Zi day epoch;200 annual CNY dates with raw-file hashes.
verification.independent: 45 lunar-python1.4.8 pillar cases, including DST profiles and both hemispheres; independent astronomical/calendar algorithm, shared pinned IANA time resolution. All200 HKO CNY dates agree; all100 Ten Gods and12 hidden-stem sets match independent lookup facts.
verification.published: Vasiloiu published PDFp12 has complete1918-12-01 12:30 solar/Asia-Shanghai/120E settings, irrespective of Romanian sample label. Software-author worked2005 chart and1988 split-Zi example. Yap annotated chart validates component facts only, lacks full birth inputs.
verification.precision: Root bracket <=.005 elapsed seconds; HKO minute-rounded comparison tolerance65 seconds. No claim of .005-second absolute astronomy, reconstructed historical UTC or independently validated IANA history.
verification.licensing: Existing pinned runtime unchanged; pip check clean. Optional lunar-python1.4.8/MIT reference only; no Swiss runtime or new production dependency. Numerical facts and short original summaries only; author-hosted PDFs/images inspected locally and removed, no full-text rights assumed.
